# Price the inspection before you've even seen the crawlspace.

> Free calculator for independent home inspectors: price a residential inspection by square footage, stories, foundation type, and home age, add radon, sewer scope, termite/WDO, and mold testing at their own fee, then check whether a week of inspections hits your income goal.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
